functions.description: Build battle record from game state
functions.notes: Whole body matches except one instruction: target has `mov r7, r0; cmp r7, #0; beq` after the second GameState::GetProtagonist() call, ours emits `movs r7, r0; beq` (4 bytes short). Tried if (p), != 0, == 0 else, goto, ternary, int/char*/GameObject* pointer types, p2 reuse of prot, split ifs: all give movs. Levers that closed the rest: struct unions with word/halfword views so struct copies inline as ldm/ldrh loops, MapEntry with Name10 members, GsView overlay for game state offsets, declaring prot/slot/lang/view at function top (swaps r4/r5), short v declared before int val, dm pointer declared after meta copy, bit stored before level.
